scope: Independent AI visual judgment of source and native-size sampled continuous windows from one G0/G1 fixture; not formal region admission or host G0/G1 signature

observed.window_method: Existing MP4 decoded to original-size PNGs only; viewed native complete frames sequentially. No video encoding or engine execution.

positive_scope: Leaf crown, brass bell opening and root feet form a recognizable grounded enemy in this quiet fixture.
Telegraph closes upward; gold ground mark stays at the locked place while player jumps away or walks left; full pulse and recovery are visibly different.
At 312 impact/cancel, ground warning disappears, hurt tint/pose and impact flash appear, and no late pulse is visible in the sampled cancellation sequence.
Final hit transitions to a low collapsed corpse, then disappears; later frames show player passing the former position.
Player moves backward while firing right; trace axis=0 during the observed first-shot window supports recoil rather than held movement.

findings.issue: Five identical flat brown triangles pop instantly at full height; they read as a debug danger comb more than the painted living root/bell attack.
findings.minimum_fix: Replace only attack presentation with a compact painted rooted silhouette or coherent shaped burst, brief emergence and collapse, with a strong contact base. Keep existing lock point, timing, pulse bounds and core behavior unchanged.
findings.retest: Native continuous prewarning→pulse→recovery window, jump and walk-out; visual footprint must agree with actual pulse.

findings.issue: 70ms atlas crossfade shows two incompatible crowns/bell placements during attack and hurt/death transitions. It proves pose changes but is not yet convincing articulated motion.
findings.minimum_fix: Use clearer planted key poses with a short controlled settle or authored intermediate pose; avoid simultaneous full double silhouettes. Preserve the grounded foot anchor and timing.
findings.retest: Same native adjacent frames plus actual normal-speed playback; no root sliding or double bell silhouette.

findings.issue: Current flat fixture, zoom1.4 and no formal HUD do not establish warning contrast or encounter readability in dense bright grass/props, on slopes or with other enemies. Gold line is thin and low against bright grass; the arc partly overlaps the player.
findings.minimum_fix: First run one controlled real solid-ground formal encounter and return path, retaining real HUD/camera and existing eligibility threshold. Include bright grass and nearby scene art; change warning presentation only if this capture loses location/danger readability.
findings.retest: One uncut formal approach→two counters→interrupt→death→pass/return; verify visual warning/pulse and placement, then independently decide promotion.

foot_anchor: No obvious hovering or skating in sampled idle/telegraph/attack/recovery/hurt/death windows on this flat fixture; slope, mirrored side and formal-route support remain unverified.
shot_recoil: Visibly readable leftward player displacement while projectile travels right in frames308–311; trace tick305–309 axis0.0 and decreasing x corroborates. No core recoil tuning is recommended.
limitations: Movie has 623 video frames while trace has 622 observations: video frame indices and native event ticks are reported separately, without assuming a universal offset.
First and final sampled video frames contain boot/end dark screen; they are not treated as scene-art failure.
Existing movie source v1 and producer_scope_bridge explicitly separate later wrapper policy fixes; old movie is not certified fresh against the later wrapper.
Evidence-deletion and output-policy counterexamples establish engineering rejection behavior only, not visual beauty.
Audio event counts, stereo metadata, asset hashes and bounding boxes do not establish heard audio, visual quality, human approval or device performance.
